description:
Staniszów Palace is a late-Baroque, two-storey building of rectangular plan, dated by a hotel listing to the end of the 18th century. Two wings were added to the main building in the middle of the 19th century.

The palace-and-park complex at Staniszów Górny 100 is on the list of the Palaces and landscape parks of the Jelenia Góra Valley recognised as a Polish Monument of History.

The palace now operates as a hotel, with an indoor swimming pool and spa access included on the rate seen, set in parkland in the Jelenia Góra Valley.

hotel.room_location_note: Rooms are in Hotel Palac Staniszow, the palace hotel at Staniszów 100
hotel.how_to_stay:
**Getting there:** At Staniszów 100, in the Jelenia Góra Valley in Lower Silesia.

**Rooms & rates:** From approx. €137/night for a 22 m² Standard Double Room with a queen bed, a view, a private bathroom and a flat-screen TV, with breakfast, unlimited spa access and one parking spot included on the non-refundable rate seen, taxes included. A rate with free cancellation was around €144.

**On-site:** An indoor swimming pool, spa access included on the rate seen, on-site parking with electric charging and free Wi-Fi.

**Good to know:** The rate seen is non-refundable, so check the free-cancellation option if your plans may change. The palace is a historic building converted to a hotel; its recognition as part of a Monument of History applies to the palace-and-park complex.

**Combine with:** [Karpniki Castle](/castles/poland/karpniki-castle), another castle hotel in the Jelenia Góra Valley.
